day_shape: 73 items: IDF captures Beaufort Castle in southern Lebanon and one soldier killed in Hezbollah drone strike, sustained Hezbollah rocket/drone barrages into Galilee, Trump reported seeking amendments to US-Iran deal over uranium stockpile, heavy regime messaging on post-war reconstruction.

threads.label: IDF captures Beaufort Castle, southern Lebanon ground push
threads.summary: The IDF announced it had retaken the Beaufort Ridge outpost and surrounding Wadi Saluki area in southern Lebanon, with Defence Minister Israel Katz saying troops would remain stationed there as part of a new security zone. Lebanese PM Nawaf Salam accused Israel of a 'scorched-earth policy' and French FM Jean-Noel Barrot called for an emergency UN Security Council meeting.

threads.label: Hezbollah drone and rocket barrages into Galilee
threads.summary: The IDF reported multiple Hezbollah drone strikes and rocket barrages across the Galilee Panhandle, Western Galilee, Kiryat Shmona, Acre, Zarit and Misgav Am, with one drone causing injuries near Kiryat Shmona and another soldier killed in southern Lebanon. The IDF Arabic spokesperson issued evacuation warnings for residents south of the Zahrani River and launched strikes on Hezbollah sites in Tyre.

threads.label: Regime channels echo Hezbollah strike claims
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press posted that a Hezbollah drone struck the Beit Hillel area for a second time and claimed Hezbollah operations targeted Israeli soldiers in Haifa, al-Bayyadah, Nahariya and Shlomi. Defa Press also published commentary headlined 'Sustainable deterrence on the Lebanon front' describing the IDF as caught between deterrence and attrition.

threads.label: Trump reported pushing changes to Iran deal
threads.summary: Times of Israel and Jerusalem Post reported Trump asked for several amendments to a US-Iran deal draft during a Situation Room meeting on Friday, focused on the fate of Iran's uranium stockpile. The Jerusalem Post separately cited a CNN report that Iran has cleared tunnel entrances collapsed by US and Israeli bombings and is poised to resume missile firings.

threads.label: Iranian post-war reconstruction and economic messaging
threads.summary: Pezeshkian told a cabinet session that external constraints and pressures had created complexities in administering the country, while Defa Press published a Civil Defence Committee 'Guideline for Reconstruction of War-Damaged Industrial Infrastructure Centres' and outlined plans for 48,000 war-damaged housing units. Khamenei's office circulated bank details for citizen donations to war-affected Iranians, and Qalibaf cited the Supreme Leader's attention to post-war issues.

threads.label: Iranian internal politics and social controls
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post and Times of Israel reported Iranian authorities shuttered a central Tehran cafe over alleged 'satanic' activities, and that Iran warned officials against 'harsh remarks that would disrupt cohesion' after hardliner comments seen as targeting Mojtaba Khamenei. The Israeli Supreme Court also extended the jail term of a convicted Iran-backed terror cell member.

threads.label: Regime claims on US base damage and border seizures
threads.summary: IRIB posted images it said showed a US KC-135 refuelling tanker at an Al-Saudi base damaged by Iranian missile strikes following Iran's 'defensive response'. Defa Press and IRIB also reported the IRGC Intelligence Organisation in West Azerbaijan seized a shipment of advanced military optical equipment in a border village of Urmia.

Governing the country in difficult circumstances requires field presence, accountability, and solidarity with the people. If people face hardships, managers must also be present alongside them and work to resolve problems. Success in overcoming upcoming challenges requires honesty, transparency, and genuine presence in the field of action. The more candidly we speak with people and involve them in the decision-making and problem-solving process, the more the country's social capital will be strengthened and the ability to overcome difficulties will improve.

events.summary_en: Images of a damaged U.S. refuelling aircraft from Iranian strikes. Oysheenist has released images of the KC-135 refuelling tanker of the U.S. Air Force which, following Iran's defensive response to U.S. bases in Saudi Arabia, was struck by explosive missiles. In these images, marks of destruction from the explosive missile impacts and repairs are visible. This refuelling aircraft belongs to the Alaska National Guard and was damaged in combat against Iran. This aircraft is the second damaged refuelling tanker in the conflict and appears to be one of at least 5 refuelling aircraft that were damaged during Iran's multiple attacks in March 2026.
